details: Mirrors currently have a very large far clipping distance and often do not have occlusion culling disabled to avoid culling issues. This often results in unnecessary draw calls because objects behind walls are not culled. Allowing mirror's far clip distances to be reduce would allow world creators to reduce the unnecessary draw calls by limiting the mirror's range.
title: Add a Far Clip Distance Setting to Mirrors
